candidate.name: Muhammad Rayyan Ahmed
credentials: M.Sc. Data Science (in progress), TU Ilmenau

letter.opening: I am applying for the Technical Data Analytics Intern position. Turning machine and production data into insights engineers can act on is what I did when I rebuilt an OEE and downtime dashboard for a manufacturer, and I would like to do the same with data from connected vacuum systems.
letter.profile_intro: I am an M.Sc. Data Science student at TU Ilmenau with a B.S. in Artificial Intelligence. Before my Master's I worked in SAP data and analytics at TallyMarks Consulting and as a Business Analyst at Tapal Tea.

achievements.impact: I independently rebuilt a textile manufacturer's spinning dashboard end to end, covering OEE, machine efficiency and utilization, downtime and yield
I used SQL analysis, validation and reconciliation to make sure reported numbers were correct
I built Python pipelines and trained PyTorch models in my thesis and projects, including a classifier with 94.11% test accuracy

letter.problems_section: I would analyse the sensor data, check its quality, build benchmarking and prioritization views with Python and SQL, and document methods and results clearly for the engineering team. I have not used Databricks yet, but I learned SAP Datasphere quickly during a migration project and expect the same here.
letter.closing: I am willing to relocate to Cologne and can start immediately. As a non-EU student I will confirm the internship schedule against my permit's work-day limits with you. I would be glad to discuss the role.
letter.language_closing: I work in English (IELTS 8.0) and am currently learning German (A1).
